events.summary: Human Rights Isn't Just for NGOs: A Conversation with PwC
events.description:
Curious about careers that connect human rights, business, sustainability, law, and global supply chains? Join us for an introduction to the growing field of Business & Human Rights, where organizations work to ensure ethical and responsible practices across their operations.

Hear from Jennyfer Leduc, Director of Human Rights Services at PwC, as she shares how human rights work comes to life in the consulting world and explores the diverse career paths shaping the future of responsible business.

events.summary: Broad Institute: Early Career Researchers Opportunities
events.description:
Join representatives from the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard for a virtual information session! Learn about the Broad’s mission to understand the causes of disease and close the gap between  new biological insights and patient impact.

Based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, The Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard is a research organization that convenes a community of researchers from across many disciplines and partner institutions—MIT, Harvard, and Harvard-affiliated hospitals. Our origins are rooted in genomics, and as biomedical research and knowledge have expanded since 2004, so have we.…

events.summary: LinkedIn & Networking
events.description: In this workshop, students will discover how to build a strong online presence, craft an engaging personal brand, and leverage LinkedIn’s features to connect with professionals in their desired fields. We’ll cover best practices for networking, including informational interviews, elevator pitches, and effective outreach strategies. Step by step, we’ll guide students in optimizing their LinkedIn profiles to attract recruiters and employers.

We’ll kick things off with a brief overview of Veeva and a look into our intern and new grad software engineering roles, then turn the focus entirely to helping you. Feel free to bring your resume for personalized feedback, get our best interview advice, and ask any burning questions about navigating the hiring process. Afterwards, stick around for…

events.location: Warren Mall, San Diego, CA 92161, USA
events.description:
What is Experience Engineering? 
Experience Engineering is the Jacobs School of Engineering's signature Family Weekend event, designed to showcase the innovation, research, and student experience that make our school one of the nation's top engineering programs. 
Families have the opportunity to explore hands-on demonstrations, meet engineering faculty and leadership, including Dean Al Pisano, and engage with student organizations, research groups, and academic departments.
